name: xeno-soundboard
description: Xenolinguistic Communication Terminal — soundboard remoto (consola + mando móvil)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.start: npm run build -w client && npm run start -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
